claims.title: 互斥完整分解优先于局部搭子累计
claims.algorithm: Enumerate mutually exclusive complete decompositions and compare effective-tile unions, weakest block and route compatibility.
claims.current_gap: NeijiangHandShapeEngine counts adjacent patterns independently and can double count overlapping structures.

claims.title: 最弱牌组决定整手牌瓶颈
claims.algorithm: Score the minimum-quality required block in addition to average shape quality.
claims.current_gap: Current shape score is mostly additive and has no minimum-block bottleneck term.

claims.title: 有效张重叠必须去重
claims.algorithm: Use tile-union mass instead of summing per-block ukeire independently.
claims.current_gap: Some heuristic bonuses are produced before a complete disjoint decomposition is known.

claims.title: 长连张和刻子有多重听口传播
claims.algorithm: Enumerate all legal winning decompositions and return the exact union of waits with shape labels.
claims.current_gap: Exact ready tiles exist, but topology and alternative decomposition explanations are not first-class outputs.

claims.title: 牌墙概率必须结合对手释放行为
claims.algorithm: Infer P(wall), P(seat holds) and P(seat releases later) separately from public action likelihood.
claims.current_gap: Current belief uses weighted aggregate evidence but lacks a full ordered-event likelihood model.

claims.title: 摸切和手切提供不同信息
claims.algorithm: Apply different rejection likelihoods and recency decay to hand-origin and draw-origin discards.
claims.current_gap: Neijiang public state does not consistently expose discard origin to the belief engine.

claims.title: 过碰过杠会改变暗手后验
claims.algorithm: Downweight hidden-hand particles inconsistent with observed pass decisions.
claims.current_gap: Pass evidence is represented but not evaluated as a unified particle likelihood sequence.

claims.title: 做清必须和普通快叫做反事实比较
claims.algorithm: Compare complete continuation values for flush and ordinary routes, including exit cost and failure tail.
claims.current_gap: Current route weights use hand-feature thresholds and local route adjustments rather than full continuation comparison.

claims.title: 宽窄色抽象为供需压力而非复制定缺结论
claims.algorithm: Estimate suit and tile demand, release and blocking pressure from Neijiang public events.
claims.current_gap: Suit demand exists but pair-callability and release pressure are not jointly modeled.

claims.title: 七对、大对子与普通路线要保留可退出性
claims.algorithm: Maintain multiple route candidates until expected-value separation exceeds a confidence-aware commitment threshold.
claims.current_gap: Primary route constraints can become too rigid before counterfactual superiority is established.

claims.title: 过碰杠必须按不同时间线估值
claims.algorithm: Pass waits for a future draw; Peng discards immediately; Gang samples a replacement draw before discard.
claims.current_gap: Neijiang reaction and self-action engines contain deep heuristics but no shared action-value transition model.

claims.title: 中张刻子杠牌要计入结构机会成本
claims.algorithm: Price lost sequence and wait-topology options in addition to immediate gang income.
claims.current_gap: Self-gang scoring compares shanten and live ukeire but lacks exact structural option value.

claims.title: 所有动作最终使用内江结算净值
claims.algorithm: Project per-seat net settlement for Hu, gang income, rob-gang, gang-discard transfer, refunds and end-of-wall settlement.
claims.current_gap: Heuristic action scores are not yet proven equivalent to final settlement for every special event chain.

claims.title: 两步进张后必须重算最佳弃牌和听口
claims.algorithm: For each first draw, enumerate legal next discards and exact waits; do not treat improvement as completion.
claims.current_gap: FairBranch follows this pattern but lacks full wait topology and calibrated conditional probability.

claims.title: 平均值之外需要尾部风险
claims.algorithm: Report expected value, dead-branch probability, quantiles and CVaR rather than only mean and single worst branch.
claims.current_gap: Current FairBranch exposes expectation and a single worst branch.

claims.title: 防守应比较净损失且针对主要威胁
claims.algorithm: Use threat-specific loss, own speed cost and opponent advancement cost, then build a Pareto frontier.
claims.current_gap: Defense is detailed but remains embedded in additive candidate adjustments.

claims.title: 整局输赢不能直接作为单步策略标签
claims.algorithm: Train and promote on per-decision counterfactual regret and probability calibration, not raw round outcome.
claims.current_gap: NeijiangLearningEngine adjusts global parameters from round score, win, self-draw, gang and draw rates.

claims.title: 五块结构需要同时处理六块冗余与四块成长
claims.algorithm: Enumerate complete block allocations, penalize redundant sixth blocks and value growth paths for incomplete fourth blocks.
claims.current_gap: Current additive shape terms do not expose block-count topology or the identity of the bottleneck block.

claims.title: 对子价值取决于顺子期权与可碰释放率
claims.algorithm: Evaluate a pair as both a pair candidate and a sequence resource, then combine remaining copies with opponent release probability.
claims.current_gap: Pair pressure and local adjacency are scored separately without a shared counterfactual value.

claims.title: 复杂或近分局面使用精确枚举裁决
claims.algorithm: Use fast features for broad ranking, then exact decomposition and wait enumeration for close candidates or complex shapes.
claims.current_gap: Exact ready checks are not used as a general near-tie structural adjudicator.

claims.title: 同一弃牌集合的顺序不同应产生不同后验
claims.algorithm: Replay public events chronologically with state-dependent likelihoods and recency decay.
claims.current_gap: Aggregate evidence can erase event order and the state in which each action was chosen.

claims.title: 报叫和报杠必须比较约束后的完整未来
claims.algorithm: Compare declare and non-declare timelines after applying all future legal-action restrictions and settlement consequences.
claims.current_gap: Availability flags and discard-oriented hints do not prove a full declare-versus-pass recommendation.

claims.title: 点碰点杠的推进损失属于防守成本
claims.algorithm: Add expected opponent advancement, exposed-meld value and gang income to immediate deal-in loss.
claims.current_gap: Danger is richer than deal-in probability but is not yet unified with all opponent advancement outcomes.

claims.title: 概率树必须使用条件分母并保持牌数守恒
claims.algorithm: Update wall composition after every sampled draw and action; never multiply unchanged marginal probabilities as independent events.
claims.current_gap: Proxy two-ply scores are not guaranteed to be calibrated conditional win probabilities.

claims.title: 题库、调参与晋升评测必须隔离
claims.algorithm: Separate extraction fixtures, tuning seeds and blind promotion suites; report performance on every split.
claims.current_gap: A single simulation pool can reward overfitting to known scenarios or seeds.

claims.title: 解释必须来自候选计算而不是事后生成
claims.algorithm: Persist the actual factors, branches and rule projections used for ranking and expose them as structured reasons.
claims.current_gap: Human-readable hints can diverge from the exact values that selected the action.

claims.title: 四川血战和定缺结论不能作为内江策略事实
claims.algorithm: Transfer only the comparison method; recompute all legal actions and payoff values from Neijiang rules.
claims.current_gap: Cross-project naming similarity can hide rule-specific assumptions.
